vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1650 (Category B corpus namespacing + allow-list removal); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Category B corpus namespacing and conformance allow-list removal

narratives.Description: Migrate the existing vBRIEF corpus so the two directive-owned Category B keys (plan.policy, plan.completedNote) move under the x-directive/ extension namespace, then delete the temporary conformance allow-list once the corpus is clean. This is a corpus-wide scripted migration, so it is marked sequential and run solo as one operation.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add an idempotent codemod that rewrites Category B keys (plan.policy -> plan["x-directive/policy"], plan.completedNote -> plan["x-directive/completedNote"]) across every vbrief artifact, run it, and validate the whole corpus. 2. Remove the ALLOW_LIST from the conformance module packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/conformance.ts and update its tests so the conformance gate enforces namespacing with no exceptions; run the conformance verify suite.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the corpus namespaced and the allow-list removed, so that the conformance gate enforces x-directive/ namespacing with no grandfathered exceptions.

items.title: Given the corpus, when the codemod runs, then every artifact validates with namespaced keys

narrative.Acceptance: Given the full vbrief corpus, when the codemod runs, then every artifact validates and the Category B keys are under x-directive/.

items.title: Given a clean corpus, when the allow-list is removed, then the conformance gate stays green

narrative.Acceptance: Given the namespaced corpus, when the ALLOW_LIST is deleted, then the conformance gate runs green without exceptions.

items.title: Given a stray non-namespaced key, when the gate runs, then it fails and names the artifact

narrative.Acceptance: Given an artifact with a bare Category B key outside x-directive/, when the conformance gate runs, then it fails and names the artifact.

x-tracking.sequential_reason: corpus-wide migration over hundreds of files; single scripted operation

expected_outputs: corpus namespaced under x-directive/; conformance ALLOW_LIST removed; conformance gate green
